rooms.name: The Throne Hall Under the Hills

objects.description: The first king's throne is carved from burial stone and black glass. It waits at the end of the hall like a verdict.

intro.text:
The final stair leads below the graves, below the ossuaries, below even the oldest roots of the hills.
There, beneath the world of the living, waits a kingdom that was never allowed to die.
You see stone roads lined with dead soldiers. Empty houses carved into cavern walls. Banners hang without wind. At the center of it all rises a palace of burial stone, its towers pressing against the underside of the earth.
The dead stand in silence as you pass.
Not all are hostile. Some look afraid.
At the palace gates, the Ashen Herald waits one last time.
"His Buried Majesty receives you," it says.
The gates open.
In the throne hall beyond sits the first king, wrapped in royal burial cloth and ancient armor.
His eyes burn like coals under a funeral crown that is no longer there.
"My crown," he says. "My blood. My kingdom."
His gaze passes over each of you.
"My army will destroy everyone that stands in my way."

outro.text:
The King Beneath falls from the throne dais like a statue finally remembering it is dust. The palace holds its breath. One by one, the dead soldiers lower their weapons, and the frightened dead in the carved houses lift their faces toward a silence they have never known.

The Barrow Crown breaks in the party's hands. Not into treasure, but into a blade-black shard, sharp with the end of command. Where it falls, the stone roads crack. Where it shines, no corpse kneels.

Above, the hills will still have graves. Below, the kingdom that was never allowed to die begins, at last, to become a tomb.

waveEncounter.goalText: Survive all five waves and kill the King Beneath.
waveEncounter.completeLog: The King Beneath is defeated. The broken crown gives up its shard, and the exit is ready.

5.title: The King Rises
5.text:
The throne hall goes still. Even the dead who came to kill you stop moving.

On the dais, the first king places both hands on the arms of his burial throne. Stone cracks beneath his fingers. The empty space where the Barrow Crown should rest burns like a wound above his brow.

"No more servants," he says. "No more heralds. If the living world refuses my crown, I will take the argument in my own hands."

His Buried Majesty rises, and the whole palace kneels around him.

overrides.role: First king of the buried dynasty
